## Identity

## Current work

Lead Full Stack Software Engineer at AllChrono (https://allchrono.com), a luxury-watch trading marketplace. Owns product architecture across Next.js surfaces and a NestJS API, and leads engineering hiring (nearly 30 senior software engineer interviews).

## Earlier career

- Co-founded Dwetech (2009 to 2016); 60+ client projects in the USA, UK, Canada, and Australia.
- Senior Software Engineer at Chaldal (YC S15), from January 2017. Built mobile web and native shopper apps from scratch (Android 1M+ downloads). Also Chalao ride-sharing, Chalao Driver logistics, GogoBangla, and Protocol.
